name: Gods of Nowhere
source:
"You can't say no to Death. It's hard to when he's renting the room right above you."

Christmas Eve, 1998.

Ichabod, meek as any young man can be, stumbles upon a bed and breakfast in the middle of nowhere. The "Heilbronner Hof". Four strangers meet there and are changed for better or for worse.

[From [url=https://detective.itch.io/gods-of-nowhere]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你没法对死神说不。当他租下你楼上的房间时，就更难做到了。”

1998年的平安夜。

性格温顺的伊卡博德在荒郊野外偶然发现了一家民宿——“海尔布隆庭院”。四名陌生人在那里相遇，他们的人生也随之发生了或好或坏的改变。

[来源：[url=https://detective.itch.io/gods-of-nowhere]itch.io[/url]]
